item.title: Silver sprints higher, gains more than 5%
item.description: Silver is up nearly 6% as it looks to break out of a recent range.These are the best levels since the crushing rout on January 30. Notably, that was the final trading day of January and this is the final trading day of February. The chart suddenly looks more promising as it breaks above the early February highs.This will mark the 10th consecutive month of gains in silver as it benefits both from the USD debasement trade along with industrial electrification demand.The gains are impressive today

item.title: Iran strikes loom large over today's trade
item.description: There is no sense over-analyzing price action today across markets. Yes, there is the usual software anxiety in stock markets but the overarching theme across bonds, FX, commodities and precious metals is simple -- angst about US strikes on Iran.That thinking has US 10-year yields below 4% for the first time since November while oil prices are up more than 2%. item.title: Nasdaq Technicals: Nasdaq index failed to extend above key MAs. Bias is lower.
item.description: The NASDAQ index pushed to a high on Monday but failed to extend above its falling 100-hour moving average, a rejection that triggered a sharp move lower. The decline reached Tuesday’s weekly low near 22,193, aligning with the top of a key swing support area.A subsequent rebound carried the index back above the 100-hour moving average, briefly increasing the bullish bias.
